## Closed as a duplicate of objectui#10657 — one family, folded into its closure card

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T15:46Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10657, and objectui `origin/main`.

Same family, one authority: a column drawn as the mask still yields its raw value through a `data-table` path. The current gate folds same-family findings into one closure card (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20110), and objectui#10657 is that card for the family objectui#10583 opened. It now carries this card's three paths (client search, client sort, `autoSizedWidths`) with their sites, at `priority:p3` · `security`, with "measure reachability first" as its first step. Neither card was claimed when the fold was made; objectui#10583 itself is in flight and was not touched.
